recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7315 unless FM later decides to revise Claim.billablePeriod semantics beyond the original STU3 request.
issue_request: FHIR-7315 was a Published/Persuasive FM change request from the 2015May ballot asking for a claim-level service date period because line item service dates are usually only included for outpatient services. Its resolution says the change was already added in STU3, and a Jira comment records that the claim header level period was added.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found. Git history shows commit 649fcd4cbf21557ae6db78e0afb908f3030dad7a, 'Updates to claim,' added a 0..1 Claim.billablePeriod Period row to the historical Claim spreadsheet source in December 2015; later source rework preserved it in the current XML StructureDefinition.
additional_context: Claim is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini entries claim=Claim and Claim=approved. The current Claim StructureDefinition has Claim.billablePeriod as a 0..1 Period and leaves Claim.item.serviced[x] optional, matching the issue's distinction between a claim header period and line-level service dates. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current source already provides Claim.billablePeriod with definition 'The period for which charges are being submitted' and a comment that line item dates of service should typically fall within the billing period when one is specified.
